Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Digital Communication Intern position. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in social media content creation, community management, and AI-assisted workflows, I'm eager to bring my skills to your mission-driven team.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, and I've built and maintained WordPress sites. On my own project, mirook.com, I've created social media content for Instagram and Facebook, and I use AI tools like ChatGPT and Canva AI daily to streamline my work. I'd love to discuss how I can support your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I'm thrilled to apply for the Digital Communication Intern position at Pulse Foundation. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, social media management, and AI-assisted workflows, I'm eager to contribute to your mission and grow under the mentorship of your AI-driven Communications Lead.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've honed my skills in content creation and management, working on SEO-optimized blog posts and website content. I'm responsible for publishing content on WordPress and tracking performance using analytics tools. This experience has made me comfortable with the technical aspects of content management and the importance of engaging audiences.

On my own project, mirook.com, I've taken on the full scope of digital communication: I designed and built the site, but also manage its social media presence on Instagram and Facebook. I create visual content using Canva and have experimented with video editing tools like CapCut to produce short clips. I use AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude daily to draft captions, brainstorm content ideas, and streamline my workflow—habits I'm excited to bring to Pulse Foundation.

I'm particularly drawn to your emphasis on community management and daily engagement. I understand the importance of building genuine connections with followers and fostering a sense of community. I'm proactive, creative, and comfortable in fast-paced environments, as demonstrated by my experience in logistics and front-end development.

I'm also eager to learn more about AI agents and automations, and I'm confident that my technical background will allow me to quickly grasp tools like Zapier and Make. I'm based in Belgium and am flexible with remote and in-person collaboration.

I would love the opportunity to contribute to your events and help bring your mission to life through compelling storytelling. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Warm regards,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · Content Creation · Social Media · AI-Assisted Workflows
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in social media content creation, community management, and AI-assisted workflows. At Episto, I manage content publishing and SEO for client websites, and on my own project (mirook.com) I've built and managed a WordPress site with integrated social media (Instagram/Facebook). I use AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude daily to streamline content creation and research. Comfortable with Canva, video editing (CapCut), and email marketing (Mailchimp). - Social Media & Community: content creation for Instagram/Facebook, community management, daily engagement, social media integration

- Video & Design: Canva, CapCut, basic video editing for social media

- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Projects

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to draft content and brainstorm ideas, and CapCut for short video edits
